<?php

foreach ([1, 6, 27, 97, 871] as $start) {
    $n = $peak = $start;
    $steps = 0;
    while ($n !== 1) {
        $n = $n % 2 === 0 ? intdiv($n, 2) : 3 * $n + 1;
        $steps++;
        $peak = max($peak, $n);
    }
    printf("%d: steps=%d max=%d\n", $start, $steps, $peak);
}
